title: Moroccan Orange Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired stew, slow-cooked in a clay pot with the sweetness of oranges.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger, garlic, cinnamon, cumin, and tagine spice blend; cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the oranges, broth, and honey; bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20-25 minutes or until the flavors have melded together.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
